description:
A multi-platform launcher for your anime games

Twintaillauncher is a multi-platform launcher that brings mod support, quality-of-life improvements, and advanced features to a variety of anime-styled games.
Bug fixes and Improvements
- Fixes an issue with WutheringWaves needing -krqlv argument
Localization
- Added russian
NOTICE
I am actively working on preparing parts and behind the scenes tools and libraries for 3.0 of TTL expect only maintenance updates while i work on the major release, this one is big LIKE BIGGER THEN 2.0 featuring full app rewrite and bunch of cool features that are long time needed, in the meantime i will make some poll for what games you wanna see added with 3.0 from our existing game requests
What's Changed
- feat(i18n): add Russian (ru_RU) translation by @vw6 in #327
- Fix wutheringwaves krqlv argument issue by @TukanDev in #331
New Contributors
- @vw6 made their first contribution in #327
Full Changelog: ttl-v2.5.0...ttl-v2.5.1
